sourceLimits: Original-project selected V2 portrait qualifies internal identity only, never external franchise canon.
Only source-visible profile/three-quarter anatomy and equipment established; rear geometry, tiny clock inscriptions and numerical chronological age unknown.
Old atlas actually opened: blond loose hair, white shoulder mantle, unarmed punches diverge from shaved scalp, brass implants, rust cape and pendulum maul. Preserve old atlas bytes.
CG05 is explicit Nexus adaptation. CG09-11 family-safe fan art. CG12-15 noncanonical What If; CG13 genderSwap only and CG15 futureExperienced only.
New settings are compatible original Meridian interpretations, not exact official location reproductions; absolute 1:1 fidelity not certified.

Coordination visual adjudication: source-certain equipment is one long rigid dark shaft, brass collars, large bronze/rust cylindrical disk head, and short chain attachment at disk. The large upper-left arch/cylinder/long vertical chain overlaps clock-city background machinery; its attribution to maul is ambiguous. Do not require or invent that full assembly in every pose. Preserve a small attached cap/hook where legible, keep rigid shaft-to-drum connection, never turn maul into flail. CG01/02 upper assembly is a local compatible interpretation, not certified source geometry.
